name: game-mobile-graph
goal: Fit the entire authored checkpoint graph on mobile and retain a selectable key checkpoint

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Native mobile authoring adds a checkpoint then cannot select Collect the key: its node remains outside the graph viewport and normal click scroll cannot reach it.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extend both existing native mobile authoring scenarios to use Fit View and require the key node fully visible before selection; desktop and tablet remain in the shared matrix.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable f9a734c8 native mobile scenarios fail after Fit View with key-node viewport ratio 0; both dimensions reproduce and captured graph pixels are retained.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Allow the graph viewport and Fit View to zoom down to 0.1 so the full authored dependency chain remains visible on narrow screens.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired immutable proof at 586caf35 and 5dbc84de runs the same mobile scenarios, tests, fixture and command: viewport ratio 0 becomes fully visible and both dimensions pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
